case_law.citation: Harris v. City of Santa Monica, 56 Cal.4th 203 (2013)
case_law.holding: FEHA mixed-motive: discrimination must be 'a substantial factor'; employer cannot escape liability by showing same decision would have been made, but can reduce damages
case_law.significance: Landmark — sets mixed-motive standard for all FEHA §12940(a) cases

case_law.citation: Yanowitz v. L'Oreal USA, Inc., 36 Cal.4th 1028 (2005)
case_law.holding: Retaliatory acts under §12940(h); 'adverse employment action' defined broadly; employer cannot retaliate for refusing illegal orders

case_law.citation: City of Moorpark v. Superior Court, 18 Cal.4th 1143 (1998)
case_law.holding: FEHA remedies: full back pay, front pay, emotional distress, punitive damages available; not limited to contract damages
case_law.significance: Confirmed full damages available in FEHA cases
